messages:
Nora: Heads-up: scheduling a TF apply in the release quiet window tomorrow 04:15 UTC. Scope: route replacement, natgw reassign, and an IAM role trust change for deployment tooling. Planning staged region rollouts with a small canary. Any objections? :wave:
Sam: No objections. Please pin providers in root to avoid surprise bumps. Also we need a tfstate snapshot + revert plan before apply.
Devin: +1. Propose canary in ap-southeast-1 for 20m, observe metrics, then proceed. Keep per-region apply to 20m max.
deploybot: change window reserved by @Nora for 2025-12-02 04:15 UTC — no overlapping deploys allowed. Required checks: tf fmt, tf validate, plan approval. Reminder scheduled 30m before window.
infra-bot: terraform plan (detached) ready — summary: adds=6, changes=3, deletes=1. Notable: prod route table replacements, natgw elastic ip swap, iam principal update. Plan link: https://ci.internal/plans/1923456789
Nora: Rollback criteria suggestion: if p95 latency >30% OR 5xx rate >0.4% sustained for 10m during canary, trigger rollback. Prepare revert apply with previous tfstate.
Sam: Provider pin snippet to add to root module:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" version = "~> 4.73" }
  }
}
```
Devin: I'll own canary validation and post the smoke script here tonight. Smoke will include health check + assume-role test + a simple request histogram check.
Nora: infra-bot please snapshot tfstate and tag with release id so revert is straightforward. Also add a job to upload revert plan to the runbook.
infra-bot: snapshot created -> s3://redwood-backups/2025-12-02/release-1923456789.tfstate.gz
oncall: Acknowledge — will be standby for rollback execution.
Sam: I'll draft the revert plan and include `terraform state pull` snapshot and targeted `terraform apply -replace=` steps. We'll limit blast radius by region.
Nora: Owners: Nora = release owner & runbook, Sam = provider pin + revert plan, Devin = canary validation, oncall = rollback executor. I'll lock merges 30m before window. :lock:
deploybot: Reminder scheduled 30m before window start.
Nora: Thanks all — final runbook + smoke script will be posted tonight.
